final_report:
T83-Fix complete — both structural gaps closed, verified live against the auto-reloaded Pi server.

GAP 1 (deterministic plan mermaid): app/llm/tools.py _run_build_plan now builds 'flowchart TD' source from the ordered nodes (one '    {node_key}[{title}]' line each, then one '{dep} --> {node_key}' edge line per depends_on entry). Titles sanitized (double quotes and square brackets removed, whitespace collapsed) via _plan_label; node keys without truthy value are skipped. Validated via ctx.mermaid_validate when provided, else lazy-imported validate_mermaid; on ModelOutputError the plan_diagram key is omitted entirely (plan still returns, nothing logged). turn.py embeds result['plan_diagram'] into the build_plan tool_result SSE event (same pattern as generate_mermaid/check_question embedding). static/sage-workspace.html gains appendPlanDiagramCard(), which reuses the EXACT generate_mermaid rendering path (buildDiagramCard + renderMermaidIn: .mermaid div via textContent + mermaid.run) — marker overridden to 'PLAN · GRAPH', title from sessionGoal or 'Lesson plan', badge validated, opens the artifacts rail and updates the count; wired into the tool_result handler for ev.name==='build_plan'. LIVE PROOF: real gemma turn returned tool_result build_plan carrying plan_diagram.source ('flowchart TD ... rec_def[What is Recursion?] ... rec_def --> base_case ...') validated as diagram_type flowchart-v2.

GAP 2 (deterministic remediation exit): tools.py _run_advance_lesson passed_check=false branch now, after set_phase('remediate'), reads the fresh phase and — when it is 'remediate' — calls LearningService.generate_check and appends stripped check_question {id, question, options} exactly like the check_due path. This inserts a gradeable kind=check row, so answer_quiz's existing rule (learning.py L225-242: correct grade while phase check/remediate ⇒ set_phase teach + teach.advance) advances deterministically even if the model never re-fires passed_check:true. messages.py PHASE_PLAYBOOK rewritten: plan section states the artifact renders automatically and forbids generate_mermaid for plans; remediation section now says REMEDIATION IS ONE ROUND with automatic fresh check card, grade with grade_answer (exact id), correct grade advances automatically, never leave the learner stuck. LIVE PROOF (session f9cd940017fa422984d086a41f4b03e5): graded-wrong REST check flipped phase to remediate; gemma chat turn fired advance_lesson{passed_check:false} and the tool_result carried summary 'remediation' plus a fresh check_question card; answering that card correctly via REST auto-advanced to next_node 'The Recursive Step' with phase back to teach — zero model cooperation needed for the exit.

SMOKE: python -m compileall app tests — OK. pytest tests/test_tools_loop.py — 18 passed. pytest tests/test_api_chat_sse.py — 16 passed + test_turn_rejects_missing_config failing, which is oc-issues.txt issue #34 verbatim (fails whenever repo .env defines BROT_API_KEY; reproduces at base commit, environmental not code). Server health ok post-reload and serving the updated workspace HTML.
